# Fishing-In-The-Deep | AI Playables Engineer Task

## 🎯 Overview
This repository contains my submission for the **AI Playables Engineer** candidate task. The objective was to create a mobile-first HTML5 playable using a hybrid workflow of AI generation (ChatGPT/Gemini) and manual technical reasoning.

## 📂 Project Structure
The repository is organized to show the progression from AI-generated output to the stabilized, final version:

*   **/Initial Implementation**: Contains the initial implementation generated by the AI based on the "Planning - V4" architecture.
*   **/Fixed Iteration**: Contains the fixed and stabilized, ready for play html.
*   **Sett-AI-Game-Engineer-Task-Yarden-Zilberman.pdf**: The full documentation of my thought process, answers on your questions, prompt iterations and technical decisions.

## 🧠 Documentation & Process
I have documented every step of the generative process, including:
*   Evaluation of 4 different planning versions.
*   The transition between LLMs (ChatGPT to Gemini) for specific logic tasks.
*   Detailed prompt engineering strategies used to enforce FSM and performance constraints.

**[Click here to view the full Process & Thought Documentation (PDF)](./Sett-AI-Game-Engineer-Task-Yarden-Zilberman.pdf)**

## 🛠️ Technical Stack
*   **Engine:** Phaser 3 (via CDN)
*   **Language:** JavaScript / HTML5
*   **Architecture:** State-Machine driven, Single-file output.
*   **Optimization:** Mobile-first responsive design, object pooling for fish, and sine-wave based pendulum mechanics.
